Freelancer & Small Biz Invoice Generator.title: Invoice Maker & Estimate App
complaints: every time they update this app the functionality changes it breaks my workflow or the app starts causing errors that they don't have fixes for right away. I've been a customer for nearly five years and I've had it. update. 8/20..not true. your "fix" was incomplete and caused 2 more issues that your support team sent over to you. i have submitted screen recordings to your support. update 8/22. yesterday's "fix" was also incomplete. I recorded a payment on an invoice and it stayed unarchived.

I've used this app for years and since they have changed there platform and joined with stripe I have hardly used it. it's confusing and complicated im going to start looking for something more user friendly and someone who actually have a person to talk to when you have a problem or have money in a account and want to withdraw it and there's no way to get help.

Be careful! They now enable a link to take payments with stripe without the owners permission to take payments. That should only be an option to turn on! It doesn't even show up on your copy of the invoice! I had to sign up for stripe to get paid, now they take a ridiculous amount of fees and I have to wait a week for my funds to hit my account. This option needs to be turned off in your settings when it should have never been active without a stripe account in the first place!

IT'S NOT FREE, more like a demo version. I am making about one invoice a month and ran out of free allowance. They definitely changed something to make everyone pay monthly or yearly. First they put their logo on the button of invoice and to remove you have to pay, then you limited to one invoice in few months? Of course you can't do any business like that, so they expect that you just subscribe. I don't need this. Will look for something better. What a shame.

Freelancer & Small Biz Invoice Generator.title: Invoice Simple: Invoice Maker
complaints: Incredibly difficult to get customer support. And the system doesn't allow for your invoices to be signed by customers. From legal and practical standpoint without having a signature on the invoice from the customer makes it incredibly difficult to deal with chargebacks or customer disputes. This is a major requirement of an invoicing system and this company refuses to implement it.

I realized a couple days ago iv been getting double charged for almost a year. I had a cheaper subscription with them and I upgraded it for unlimited invoices. and iv been getting charged for both subscriptions for almost a year now. I was told I cannot get a refund or credit or anything for the double charges. they said they arent responsible for accidental purchases. but this was NOT an accidental purchase. it was an upgrade that they messed up. this is on them. HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE too.

The app works thats a plus. The fact they keep increasing the price is garabage. I couldnt be more disgusted with forced price increases. I use the same exact options in the app that I've used for the past 10 years and not 1 single new "update" option at all period. why would I want to continue to pay more and more for things I dont need. Definitely will be looking for other apps to use that actually care about ALL their customers. Not just about upcharging forcefully.

Two huge price increases in 2 years. App is good. But not great. They keep adding things to justify their price increases, but refuse to offer a lite version for those of us (like me) that don't need all the bells and whistles. I swear they are worse than the cable company. Charging you for things you didn't need or want! Will be cancelling after my subscription year is up!

Freelancer & Small Biz Invoice Generator.title: Freebie Invoice Maker Simple
complaints: Maybe I'm missing something but this app is NOT free. It is to download but not to use exclusively for free. After creating only 5 invoices I was prompted to upgrade my plan and not allowed to create any more. The most basic subscription is $49.99 per year but only allows 3 invoices per month!? Even for a small business, that's no where near enough.

was an absolutely amazing app I used for all of my invoices. I make 10 to 20 odd invoices a month for free. new update released and suddenly it's $100 a year to only have 10 a month when it was free for unlimited. jumping straight to $200 anually for unlimited is a huge jump from free and not justifiable when not gaining any significant functionality compared to what was free to me for the past 2 years.

Was great, now not so much. It's a great, simple, easy to use app that used to be free (as the name would suggest) then out of the blue without warning they cut usage to only a few invoices per year unless you pay for subscription. Their prices are way too high, I switched to Zoho

Boy. Really had me going here for a second. I thought wow, so convenient. Easy to use. After sending out 25 invoices and working all morning adding customers to this app, I began getting response emails stating only black pages show up on attachment. Or won't allow at all. When I make my secondary email a customer and send myself a bill, it says "corrupted file" and it's unable to open. I take my business pretty seriously and this is absolutely horrible. Embarrassing and makes me look very bad.

Freelancer & Small Biz Invoice Generator.title: Invoice Generator - Zoho
complaints: So far I am less than impressed with this app. From what I can tell you cannot simply add an invoice to an email I have to take a picture of it save it to my phone and then upload that picture to my email huge inconvenience along with not being able to edit or delete things that I've added to my list to add to my invoice, a huge oversight and a major inconvenience. I will keep my rating at 1 star until fixed and probably find a different app.

Inconsistent with online instructions. There is no download option in the menu. Will not allow me to edit invoice. Accidentally changed to French headings and menus. Will not allow me to switch it back to English. I switch it to English in the business information section but it will not save. There's no indication of how to save it. I never changed or saved the French intentionally. I can only assume I accidentally hit the language menu. Bad design. Time waster.

Sucks!!! I still cannot log into this app to make it save one single invoice!?!!!!!!???? It's nothing but easy do not waist an hour like I did getting redirected redirected again and again!! I'm installing once I got my other invoice maker downloaded! Right now I'm on a time crunch!! Do not leave it to Zoho!!!
First time was ok. Then second and third time was harder. Quicker and more reliable writing it by hand. No such thing as a free invoice app. Make your own invoice template and save time and money

Freelancer & Small Biz Invoice Generator.title: Invoice Maker - InvoiceBase
complaints: NOT FREE!! You use the word "free" no less than 15 TIMES! in the description of this app. Apparently, that's only if you don't have more than 5 items to put on an invoice. Why not be honest & let people know the limitations before they waste their time downloading it?! I realize that you worked hard to make the app & you're entitled to make money from it. I JUST EXPECT YOU TO BE HONEST UP FRONT, AND YOU'RE NOT. Because of that, your app was immediately deleted. YOU DECEIVE, I DELETE.

the app stopped working just 1 week after i purchased the one year vip version. Despite providing the necessary details, the invoice remains blank. I've dispatched a couple of emails to the customer support team without any reply, and I'm at a loss on how to request a refund. Given my daily requirement for the app, I'm compelled to seek an alternative invoicing service as this one is completely inoperable. I'm disappointed! Waste of money 😕

Once again another invoice template app that says it's free and it is but only for a few days then it completely stops working until you pay their fees! TRULY MISLEADING! I understand that these invoice template apps say they have to charge these fees to improve their products but they should never be in Google play store free apps searches! TRULY MISLEADING

I used to love ur app...but now it's not the best. Can't sync data, and try sending an email to customer support and u get no response. I paid for the lifetime membership and ud think u get help but nothing. I had 3 years worth of data and now that I upgraded to a new phone none of the data syncs over. keep getting a message saying 0/6 items synced please try again, do it over and over and get nothing. Very poor customer service and because this issues makes for a poor app now.

Vehicle Mileage & Expense Tax Tracker.title: Everlance: Mileage Tracker
complaints: I gave Everlance several days of real-world testing, and it was too unreliable for business mileage. It created phantom trips while I sat at home, merged drives across a 10-minute stop, and once started a trip 21 minutes before I actually left, logging 4.5 miles for a drive TripLog correctly recorded as 2.4. TripLog matched the rest of my driving exactly and has a much cleaner daily timeline showing stops and legs together. I wanted automation, not constant cleanup. TripLog was the clear winner.

Works great... until it doesn't. ​I make it a point to classify my drives after every single trip—or at least at the end of the day if it’s all from one job. Somehow, I opened the app to find over 100+ unclassified trips stacked up over the last month and a half. ​How is that even possible if I'm staying on top of it daily? Either the app is silently losing/resetting saved classifications, or phantom trips are being auto-generated in the background without notification. Disappointing to see to

I relied on the free tier, but after your first 30 trips, the app locks your data. The worst part? It automatically deletes those locked trips after some time, effectively holding your data hostage! There is no upfront warning about this when you start—they only tell you after you've hit the limit. Deleting locally stored user logs without permission is unacceptable. If you can't afford a premium subscription, avoid this app or you will lose your records.

Had to uninstall the app since it stopped tracking and it wouldn't me log in. I reset my password and it said I had too many attempts and had to try again later but did not specify when to try. I was already at the restaurant to pick up so I needed the app to work. Called support, lady was very nice and professional but told me that the system locks you out for 45 minutes! She could not reset it so I had to wait the 45 minutes and try my new password. I canceled my renew, better apps out there!

Vehicle Mileage & Expense Tax Tracker.title: Stride: Mileage & Tax Tracker
complaints: Overall it's a good product! Since they changed to the new yellow icon, their service has gone downhill. I lost 179 miles today and a couple hundred more over the past week. Now, it seems that if you're not on this app, it no longer keeps track of mileage. The app has full access to locations, free from being optimized, and no limits. Now, it does not work like it used to. I never had problems where I've lost miles like this. I'm having to go back and calculate how many miles I've actually lost.

Difficult to manually start mileage tracking when it doesn't automatically start. Also it sometimes auto-starts when I'm walking through the house with my phone. Just updated, and all my 2023 transactions are gone. I'm going back to writing down my mileage in a tiny notebook. It also really, really wants to be a full bookkeeping/tax app. I already have that, I just didn't want to have to remember to log my miles!

Absolutely the worst app to track any mileage on your vehicles. I've used this app for over 3 years and it's done great until they released a update and it went downhill after that lol. I gave them a chance and have been hoping that they would fix this issue but no, it has been over a month. I'm now losing money. When I start/stop my travel It won't stop, it will continue. I have it now at 96hrs of driving. Your button for completing my drive has not been working

Your app just stops tracking miles. This has been happening for over 3 months, I have uninstalled it and then reinstalled it a week or two later over the last 3 months to see if it's fixed and it has not been fixed. For example today I've driven 105.5 mi and your app says I've driven 24.5. it keeps accurate track of the time. Just not the miles. I really hope you fix this problem for those that are having it, I will no longer be trying to use this app.

Vehicle Mileage & Expense Tax Tracker.title: Mileage Tracker by Driversnote
complaints: This app is shady! There is NO indication that you start on a limited plan: it does NOT tell you upfront you must pay to access full reports for filing taxes, NO subscribe banner anywhere, and NO suggestion to upgrade your account under Settings > Your Account. Nothing. Complete silence!! I only discovered the subscription requirement when I looked into the iBeacon. About that subscription: other mileage tracking apps cost MUCH less while also letting you track other business expenses. Pathetic!

The new process of adding notes to trips is poor at best. Why the extra steps and another page to pop up? Why couldn't you have just left the app alone? Before the latest update on 8/17/26 the app was finally working well. Since it was, that should have been a sign that unnecessary changes were coming. Definitely time to find a different mileage app.

awful. Got it to track my work trips. You have to pay a ton of money for it record more than 15 trips a month. I'm someone who juggles 3 delivery jobs. It never said anything about paying and then locked my recorded trips behind a paywall. I need those for Taxes! I'll be losing money because of this. Edit: If you actually look into what people don't enjoy about the app, it's all the same. I found a way better solution. I am just hoping that I won't suffer too bad of taxes because of you.

had this app for 2-3 years. It was not always perfect, but was sufficient to track what I needed. Unfortunately some recent updates have created chaos in its use. The worst part, is that support is truly helpless. They will always answer back to your email, but All they do is give you generic answers, don't really read your questions and really have little understanding of the questions you ask or bring up. Would not recommend it after the new changes and with the type of support you get.

Landlord & Tenant Rental Manager.title: rmResident
complaints: I got set up fine, got to view past payments, was able to fill in future auto payments and saved them. but never saved them ,not able to confirm if will work, since can't find any records of it . I was told to try again ,I did ,5 different times over a week period ,nothing different and not able to get any support from the app or management. what a waste of time!!!!

I pay enough for an outdated apartment that always has issues. Now with this new payment app, I'm paying an additional $6.95 convenience fee(not a convenience for me). The app is easy to use once set up but when will hard working people stop being gouged to death by more & more $$$ being paid out??? Pay wages don't go up at a fast enough rate to keep up with all the increases.

It wants you to choose your state in a Dropbox selection for your billing info and the box doesn't work. They charged me a "convenience fee" to process paying rent even while paying 2 days early and from a bank account. That fee gets more expensive depending on if you're using bank or card and what type of card. Positive reviews mocking the negative ones lookin fake af. Then it has the audacity to ask me how I'm enjoying the app. I am not. Thanks.

Adding a convenience fee to every form of payment isn't convenient, it's a rent increase. My property management no longer accepts payments outside of this app/website. Most other digital payment software such as Cashapp, Zelle, Venmo, Paypal, etc. don't have these charges when doing transfers, so I'm going to recommend they switch to another digital banking service.

Landlord & Tenant Rental Manager.title: AppFolio Property Manager
complaints: Now charges a service fee for direct bank transfers, so there is no longer ANY payment option that doesn't include additional fees!! I've never seen ANY other company tack on a fee like this. Other places only charge if you pay by credit card! On top of that, they still bill management companies monthly to use their product. Corporate greed, plain and simple. Their software isn't even very good. Do not support these guys!

Would rather keep books on paper than use AppFolio. Appfolio prides itself on being an accounting based property management company when in reality they don't have a clue on bookkeeping/accounting. They will tell you whatever you want to hear to get you to buy their product including stating it replaces quickbooks. To say it has been hell on the accounting side is an understatement and I wouldn't recommend this product to anyone. The onboarding process was also a nightmare.

I have to constantly close the app out and restart the app, just to get a work order to load. it's been this way for over a year. loading receipts in usually is a 10-20 minute ordeal because the app crashes and needs to be closed out and restarted. Definitely the worst app I've ever used!

Inconcept the Appfolio is a good idea. the app itself does not work very well. Several bugs. The app kicks you back to the dashboard constantly, logs you out on a regular basis, sends messages on its own amongst several other issues. They are very proud of all the things that they update and the use of AI but the issues that make the app hard to use aren't ever addressed. A 1 star rating is being generous.

Landlord & Tenant Rental Manager.title: SimplyWise: Receipts, Expenses
complaints: I'm pretty disappointed. I wanted to try out the free version of the app and determine whether it's worth paying for the premium options. The free version was incredibly glitchy on my Samsung device. Every time I tried to create my own categories rather than select the default ones, it would allow me to search for an icon, but tapping on the icon I wanted did absolutely nothing. I was unable to move past this. The only way I was able to continue setup was if I selected at least 3 default options

Now, a REAL review: WARNING!! Avoid! The app tricks you to give them your phone number before you find out how expensive it is. Also they are spamming my email address even though I opted out durring setup. Now I regret giving my phone#. The price is not an option. In the free version, you can't do anything worthwhile. Sometimes you have to re-scan receipts to get accurate readings. For the price, it needs to be flawless. UPDATE: The business version option is a must but its almost $100/yr.

Skip. The so called free version only allows 50 saves and then you have to pay $30 annually to use it. Its reciepts, its not worth it. There are free apps for that. Customer service sucks, very dry people. They don't offer any discounts or promotions. They don't offer a lifetime version when you can pay a flat rate once. Personally, I'm not interested in another yet subscription. And the whole "free" version is bait and switch. Uninstalling the app and highly recommending looking elsewhere.

I'm trying out budget aps. This one tracks through email receipts and receipts you enter by taking a picture. I don't see a way to just track starting with 1-1-24. My 2023 email receipts are included. This is just confusing. It also means I have fewer receipts I can have before I have to pay $29.99 for a year of unlimited scans. The worst part is there is no way I can see to get customer service.

Landlord & Tenant Rental Manager.title: Landlordy: Rent Manager App
complaints: confusing & stupid. i can't do a simple things. paid for unlock, but it's got me another problem. Their tutorial is even worse. in 2026 , people still can't build a simple app!!!!!
It only has options for rent payment for weekly or monthly.. No yearly. I don't get
My landlord never put me in for another year lease, I was promised one through.the program Rapid Rehousing I. Also he never applied for emergency rental assistance. HELP
why do I need premium to input my countries currency, terrible

Inventory & Stock Barcode Scanner.title: Mobile Inventory: Scan & Count
complaints: I spent hours.... HOURS... scanning barcodes of the items in my inventory, taking photos, and typing up descriptions... Then had to buy a new phone and my inventory lists were not backed up. I tried to click "back-up and restore"... Which apparently is only a feature available for the "Premium Version". Didn't even know there was a "Premium Version"... Now all my time is wasted. Bye, bye and never again.
Place the code in the window. Sure except it's so blurry it can't scan at all. I know it's not my phone as I've tried other scanners and they scan no problems.
1 free export. 6 minutes i can't get back. Thanks.
huge subscription charges

Inventory & Stock Barcode Scanner.title: Stock & Inventory Simple:StoDo
complaints: Not sure what happened...I downloaded this app yesterday and got all my pictures and inventory set up. It looked great. Everything was in alphabetical order. Should everything I needed. Opened the app this morning and everything was good. Checked back to update my inventory and everything was gone. The entire item list and photos were there, but inventory was zeroed out on everything... nothing but lost time.

Was looking for something easier than a spreadsheet to keep my cost of goods up to date. This indicated that it could do so, but turns out its behind a paywall, even though "Register Sales and Purchases;" does not indicate as such in its discription... Response..not expecting everything free.

Absolutely ridiculous. If you want to add prices, you have to pay for a subscription... Which says you'll receive a 'free' 7 day trial, but wants to charge your card first. I recommend NOT INSTALLING. It is a complete waste of time.

After I wasted time inputing for my store. I realized there's no log in and no way to really share information across stores with multiple users. Horrible experience and design. Only cloud based and having to add Gmail accounts is running around in circles.

Inventory & Stock Barcode Scanner.title: Inventory Management App -Zoho
complaints: Was using the simple inventory tracker app when it popped up saying I could use groups for items in this inventory app. Sounded great so I downloaded it.Except the group function doesn't do anything.Its just a blank page with sort/filter settings that are useless. There is no way to add items to groups on the group page or while adding or editing an item This was the one feature I needed and that was ADVERTISED TO ME and it doesn't even work. Now questioning if I should use any zoho app at all.

Required enabling javascript to sign in through google account. Took a couple retries anyway, and even when I managed I couldn't add any item (error: "select already one type", but no type ui element). Was unable to setup automatic sync/backup (looked specifically for google drive integration).

The app looked quite nice. Lots of different item description options etc. But in this inventory management application you cannot actually track the location of your inventory which is literally step bloody one. Absolute utter joke of an app. Deleted and will never use again especially seeing as how the company itself said that it would have that feature out in 2021. So they also shamelessly lie to their customers FYI.

I got frustrated because I am trying from 1 month to sign in but it always say ' something went wrong please try later' Very bad performance. I didn't expected this type of error from such a reputed company.
